## Introduction

BridgeNet automates bridge hub identification between drug targets and disease core genes.

## Quick start

```r
library(BridgeNet)
targets <- read_targets("SwissTargetPrediction.csv")
edges <- build_bridge(targets, core_genes = c("BID"))
result <- find_bridge_hub(edges, core_genes = c("BID"))
print(result$bridge)
plot_bridge(result$graph, highlight = c("BID", "MCL1", "CTSS"))
